content:
maria: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421 needs a quick review + backport into release-2.1. Small lint fix but touches model-loading path so want another pair of eyes before cut.
jon: on it. what's the blocker right now? CI failing?
maria: failing lint + one flaky unit test on gpu-matrix. fixed lint in a follow-up commit, pushed. the gpu test failure was due to a seed; i force-pushed a deterministic seed change.
tara: can you paste the exact commands you ran to repro the flaky test? i want to sanity-check the change.
maria: sure — locally i ran: ```pytest tests/test_gpu_matrix.py::test_kv_cache --maxfail=1 -q``` then `pytest -k kv_cache -q` after the seed change it passed 10x locally.
jon: running CI now (sandbox). will report back.
sam: FYI for release: when this merges we need a one-line changelog in CHANGES.md under 2.1 section: "Fix: lint and deterministic seed for kv cache to prevent intermittent OOMs" — can you add that in the same PR or should we do a backport PR?
maria: i can add the changelog entry to the PR and create a backport commit afterwards. plan: merge to main, then cherry-pick to release-2.1 with label `backport/2.1`.
release-coordinator: cut window is today 18:00 UTC. anything merged before 17:30 gets included in the candidate, after that we need an explicit approval.
tara: CI shows a failing integration test in nightly, unrelated to this change (timeout). jon, you still seeing lint fail?
jon: lint is clean now. gpu test passed in CI too. deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks ✅ (build, unit, lint, integration: timeout flake ignored).
jon: LGTM from me.
tara: small nit in comment, but non-blocking. leaving :+1: after nit addressed.
maria: updated comment per tara, added CHANGES.md entry and signed-off commit. also created backport branch `backport/8421-2.1` with cherry-pick and pushed.
sam: great — can someone add the `needs-release` label on main PR and `backport` label on the backport branch?
jon: added both labels.
release-coordinator: I see both PRs linked. marking for 18:00 candidate. thanks all.
maria: thanks! feel free to merge when green.
jon: merged main PR at 1791234590. backport PR merged at 1791234615. will notify release channel if anything unusual.
release-coordinator: noted — including in today's candidate list. :shipit:
